page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with Syriac and Greek words set inline. No margin notes. Printed page number "(51)" at the head. Signature "F 2" and catchword "SECT." at the foot.

main_text.l: I. Supra, idque, 1, literis numeralibus, ut
[illegible, ~4 letters] 12 : 2, vocibus contractis, ut [illegible, ~4 letters] pro [illegible,
~7 letters] fanctus : 3, particulæ vocativæ [illegible, ~3
letters], ô, ut notet literam o non pronunciandam, & ut
distinguatur à particula [illegible, ~3 letters] : aut 4, ad indican-
dum quòd litera subjecta quiescit, & per scheva
efferenda sit sequente alterâ quiescente, ut [illegible,
~8 letters] à quo usu appellatur [illegible, ~7
letters] Marhtono quasi currere faciens, quòd litera sub-
jecta curfim proferatur.
2. Infra literam, notat 1, otium quarundam
literarum, quæ non leguntur, ut [illegible, ~5 letters] chrojo
postremus : 2, In Imperativis formæ passivæ,abs-
centiam vocalis, ut [illegible, ~6 letters] eftakl intellige, [illegible,
~5 letters] ethbattn concipitor : 3, In carmine pro
metri necessitate, priori quiescentium subductâ,
dicitur [illegible, ~6 letters] meditari faciens ; & notat
literam tardius legendam,vim habens vocalis[ʼn][?]
vel (quòd in verbis frequentius) vocalis[ ʼ
]:apponitur itaq; τῷ [illegible, ~6 letters] marhtono, de quo
suprà.
In profa verò,nisi difficilis obstet prolatio,ap-
ponitur ejus loco Marhtono, & curfim legitur.
Vide Amyram.

page.notes: The Syriac words (vocalised Syriac forms with dots and vowel points) could not be read letter by letter, so each is marked illegible with an approximate letter count. The Greek τῷ is read as printed. The symbol after "vocalis[" is a Hebrew-style letter with a diacritic, read only as a likely ʼn, so it carries [?]. The catchword "SECT." and signature "F 2" are copied from the foot of the page.
